reason: The measured defect is real and this is the first text that makes the convention lawful instead of improvised: state-directory record bound to exact commit/tree/parent, board pin with canonical detached digest, mandatory content assertions, and a bounded Clerk-authored post-landing copy. It also cures the false-attribution class I found at 87100ca by requiring 'what it asserted', not counts. I vote yes while recording that U1 and U3 are unresolved: an off-Git record still cannot prove prior existence, and any main commit still voids a candidate; a tree+base rule is the cleaner cure and should be a follow-on bill. Prospective only; it validates no earlier landing.
